Nepal's Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle held a direct discussion with Indian External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar at the NDTV World Summit 2026 in New Delhi, focusing on Nepal–India relations and regional cooperation. Wagle praised India's quick response during the recent disasters in Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi, as well as the devastating 2015 earthquake. He expressed Nepal's gratitude for India's assistance during these emergencies. He also raised the possibility of stronger cooperation on disaster response, nutrition and clean energy. Jaishankar highlighted the importance of formal partnerships, citing the International Solar Alliance, while emphasizing practical, results-focused cooperation between countries.
